name: antares
description: Open-source editor interface for the Muse Code agent, built on the official Muse Server Protocol (MSP).

author.name: Antonio Rafael Souza Cruz de Noronha

viewsWelcome.contents:
**Antares**, an open interface for Muse Code.

[Open Antares](command:antares.open)

[Show subscription usage](command:antares.showUsage)

[Set up local voice](command:antares.setupVoice)

The Antares chat opens beside your editor. If shell commands fail with "sandbox unavailable", switch the chat to Bypass permissions (see docs/SANDBOX.md in the repository).

antares.musePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `muse` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, then the default install location).

antares.dev.provider.markdownDescription: Development only: Muse provider id (e.g. `echo`) for offline testing. Leave empty for normal use.

antares.offerCatalogs.description: Offer once to add a few suggested catalogs (Anthropic's official plugin marketplace and Anthropic's Agent Skills) so there is something to install from. Nothing is added unless you accept.

enumDescriptions: Reading only; shell and file-write tools are also disabled at the host (recommended).
Automated reviewer decides first and escalates to you.
Per the Muse contract: no sandbox, no approval prompts. Use with care.
antares.initialProfile.markdownDescription: Permission profile a new Antares chat starts with. You can change it per chat from the header; changing it starts a new chat.

antares.usage.alerts.markdownDescription: Warn when the 5-hour or weekly usage reaches one of the thresholds below. Alerts use the numbers Muse last reported, which are as of that moment, not live.

antares.usage.alertThresholds.markdownDescription: Percentages that raise an alert, for each window. Each fires once per window and re-arms when the usage falls back below it.

antares.usage.refreshOnOpen.markdownDescription: Read fresh usage when an Antares chat opens, using Muse's `usage/refresh` (experimental, rate-bounded to one per minute; it makes no model call). Turn off to rely on the numbers Muse reports after each message.

antares.usage.statusBar.markdownDescription: Show the 5-hour and weekly usage in the status bar once Antares has been used in this window.

enumDescriptions: Use faster-whisper when it is set up, else Windows speech recognition when Windows has a recognizer for it.
Local Whisper on your CPU (more accurate; one-time setup of about 450 MB).
The speech recognition built into Windows (offline, nothing to install, lower quality; Windows needs a desktop speech recognizer installed, which not every PC has).
antares.voice.engine.markdownDescription: Which engine turns your voice into text. Audio never leaves your computer with either engine.

antares.voice.language.markdownDescription: Spoken language: `auto` (Whisper detects it; Windows speech uses the editor language), a code such as `pt` or `en`, or a locale such as `pt-BR`.

enumDescriptions: About 75 MB. Fastest, makes more mistakes.
About 145 MB. A good balance on a CPU.
About 465 MB. More accurate, slower, needs more memory.
antares.voice.model.markdownDescription: Whisper model for faster-whisper. Changing it needs `Antares: Set up local voice` to download the new model.

antares.voice.home.markdownDescription: Folder where local voice (the private Python environment and the model, about 450 MB) is installed. Empty uses the standard per-user location. Set by `Antares: Set up local voice` when you choose a folder.

antares.voice.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.9+ used to create the private environment. Empty looks for `py -3`, `python` and `python3`.

antares.voice.maxSeconds.markdownDescription: Longest single dictation, in seconds. Recording stops by itself at this length.

antares.voice.idleMinutes.markdownDescription: The Whisper worker is stopped after this many idle minutes to give its memory back.

antares.dev.voice.markdownDescription: Development only: fake recorder and transcriber (no microphone, no engine).

antares.dev.patch.markdownDescription: Development only: path of a host patch file (`*-tool_patch.json` under a `tool-outputs` folder). When set, the panel shows a todo list and an `edit_file` call for that patch as soon as it opens, so the diff view can be checked without a model turn.

antares.dev.patchSeries.markdownDescription: Development only: patch files for successive edits of one file, shown in order, so the cumulative diff can be checked without a model turn.

antares.dev.picks.markdownDescription: Development only: absolute paths used instead of the file dialog of the composer's `+` menu, and, as the first entry, instead of the folder dialog. For automated tests.
